prose: Kyle Jeong explains Jev, TypeSafe's class of 'System One' AI models built for fast, structured decisions that software can consume directly: state in, typed answers with probabilities out. TypeSafe claims Jev is 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than LLMs, positioning it as a frontier-intelligence function call rather than a chat model.

Jev exposes three primitives - Choice, Score and Noul - and the article walks through a customer-support example where one call routes a message to the right department and detects an explicit refund request. Jeong's goal is to teach what Jev is, why it exists, and how to introduce it into production systems.
highlights: Jev: 'System One' models for fast, typed decisions software can use directly
Claimed 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than LLMs
